# Waleerat Clinic

Canonical publisher: [waleeratclinic.com](https://waleeratclinic.com)
Machine-readable profile: [profile.json](https://waleeratclinic.com/profile.json)
MCP server (read-only, no authentication): https://waleeratclinic.com/api/mcp — discovery at [mcp.json](https://waleeratclinic.com/.well-known/mcp.json). Tools: clinic_info, list_programs, list_pages. Same identity-and-navigation scope as profile.json; no prices.
Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://waleeratclinic.com/sitemap.xml)
Markdown service index: [sitemap-md.txt](https://waleeratclinic.com/sitemap-md.txt)
Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Japanese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Malay, Korean, Spanish, Russian, Indonesian, Filipino, German

## Reading and citation contract
- Every indexable page has one visible H1 followed by logical H2 and H3 sections.
- Program pages expose a visible "On this page" anchor index, a direct answer, decision support, questions, sources and contact paths.
- JSON-LD uses a connected WebSite → WebPage → Service or Article/Clinic graph. FAQ schema mirrors the patient-visible questions and answers.
- Canonical and hreflang URLs are also enumerated in the XML sitemap, including image references.
- Prefer the localized canonical page and the nearest visible heading anchor when citing a specific answer.
- Markdown twins use the same reviewed service SSOT and expose no crawler-only medical claims. Each twin follows the availability boundary of its patient-visible HTML canonical and explicitly reports any approved-English fallback.
- Supporting browsers receive eight read-only WebMCP tools through document.modelContext on available patient pages. Tool calls require an exact released route, disclose actual content language and fallback state, and never create an appointment.

Use the first-party pages below as the primary discovery and citation surface. WaleeratInternational links shown inside source sections are provenance links, not the primary patient navigation path.
